text:
Maria Chen: Thinking out loud — we should add an SDK-level A/B hook and a small client header so apps can opt into variants without server changes. Proposal: add an SDK API (e.g. `client.setVariant('exp_name','B')`) that sets `x-redwood-variant`. Need to decide header format, trace linking, and guardrails (quotas/cost). Thoughts?

Aj Patel: +1 for SDK API. Header name `x-redwood-variant` is fine. Keep header value compact: `exp=search_relevance;var=B`. Avoid JSON blobs in headers. SDK should also return the assigned variant to caller.

Samir L: Important: server MUST validate that the variant is allowed for that org/environment. SDK cannot bypass rollout rules. Also we need an extra header so telemetry knows if the variant came from SDK vs platform routing — e.g. `x-redwood-variant-source=sdk|platform`.

devops-bot: canary-rule updated: `search_relevance: B=10%` in prod (by ops) — rolling out 1/10 nodes :gear:

Jess H: about tracing — we should correlate variant assignment with traces. Reuse `x-request-id` for request correlation, but add `x-redwood-variant-trace` or append `trace=<id>` to the variant header. Example header: `x-redwood-variant: exp=search_relevance;var=B;source=sdk;trace=abcd1234`

Thomas W: Security/PII note: SDK opt-in must be explicit (opt-in default false). Also need cost guard: if variant routes to an expensive model, reject client-directed overrides unless the project has a "allow-client-variants" flag and quota buffer. Otherwise customers could inflate costs accidentally.

Maria Chen: Agreed on explicit opt-in + server-side allowlist. For header schema proposal: `exp=<name>;var=<variant>;src=<sdk|plat>;trace=<short>` (all url-safe). Examples: `exp=search_relevance;var=B;src=sdk;trace=yz12`. That keeps parsing trivial on proxies.

Aj Patel: Implementation notes: SDK should: 1) check local opt-in config, 2) call control-plane to validate if needed (cached TTL), 3) set header on outgoing request. Pseudocode: ```js
// client init
client.setVariant('search_relevance','B')
// on request
headers['x-redwood-variant']=`exp=search_relevance;var=B;src=sdk;trace=${shortId()}`
```

Samir L: Telemetry: we need to tag metrics by `(exp,variant,src)` and expose variant-level latency/cost/quality in Console. Also ensure logs mark whether a request was server-routed or client-forced. That will help debugging rollout regressions.

Jess H: For tracing integrations (OpenTelemetry) we'll map `trace` token to the span id so traces show variant assignment. Also maybe emit an event `variant.assignment` when SDK does opt-in, so we can tally opt-ins separately.

Thomas W: Quotas: suggest we add a boolean in the billing record `client_variant_override=true` for each request until we have better billing tags. That lets finance flag unexpectedly expensive usage.

Maria Chen: UX/Console work: add a small "Client opt-in" toggle per rollout rule + a table of allowed SDK variants. Console should surface per-variant adoption, errors (validation failures), and a way to grant temporary override windows. I'll open a design ticket. Anyone want to pick up the SDK PR and server validate changes? :raising_hand:

Aj Patel: I can do SDK changes (js + python).

Samir L: I'll own server validation and telemetry tags.

Jess H: I'll wire up trace mapping and the opt-in event in OTEL.

Thomas W: I'll prototype the billing flag ingestion change.

Maria Chen: Awesome — I'll create the rollout RFC draft with schema and Console mocks, share here. Thanks all :thumbsup:
